select ar.Ad_Id, sum(case when ar.Ap_State = 0 or af.Af_State = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as notArchived, sum(case when ar.Ap_State = 1 and af.Af_State = 1 and (sfa.File_MD5_Code is null or latest_md5.max_key is not null) then 1 else 0 end) as archived from Archive ar inner join Archive_File af on af.Ap_Id = ar.Ap_Id left join SYS_FileAnnex sfa on sfa.file_id = af.Af_Annex_Id
where ar.P_Id = #{pId} group by ar.Ad_Id

select ranked.Ad_Id, sum(case when ranked.Ap_State = 0 or ranked.Af_State = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as notArchived, sum(case when ranked.Ap_State = 1 and ranked.Af_State = 1 and (ranked.file_md5 is null or ranked.rank_key = ranked.max_key) then 1 else 0 end) as archived from ( select project_files.*, max(project_files.rank_key) over ( partition by project_files.P_Id, project_files.file_md5 ) as max_key from ( select ar.Ad_Id, ar.P_Id, ar.Ap_State, af.Af_State, annex.File_MD5_Code as file_md5,
as rank_key from Archive ar inner join Archive_File af on af.Ap_Id = ar.Ap_Id left join SYS_FileAnnex annex on annex.file_id = af.Af_Annex_Id where ar.P_Id = #{pId} ) project_files ) ranked group by ranked.Ad_Id
